en: A colorized, painted panoramic view of a European town nestled in a lush, green valley, surrounded by low, rolling hills or small mountains. In the foreground and middle ground are many trees and villas with red-tiled roofs and white facades. Toward the center is a hill rising above the town, topped by a small structure or tower, with more town buildings spreading out beyond it. The distant background shows layered hills under a partly cloudy sky. There is no visible printed caption on the front.
